reasons: The homepage is strong. The depth is uneven. The homepage has {home_words} words (floor {floor}, median of 13 Nürnberg practice homepages {median}). The method pages have 540 to 780 words, but Magnetfeldtherapie has {words:ST-12}, Mikronährstoffe {words:ST-22}, Ursachen-Klarheitsanalyse {words:ST-26}, Wartezeit-Vermeider {words:ST-27} and Kontakt {words:ST-41} words. There is no page for PostVac and Long Covid and none for single concerns.

The relaunch changes the data. Search Console (2026-07-11 to 2026-10-09) mixes the old and the new site. 62 of the 72 page clicks went to the home page. The old concern pages are now redirect stubs to anchors of one page. The old page 'Schmerzen und Verletzungen' had 7 clicks and 71 impressions.

Own visibility. DataForSEO lists only 2 keywords with volume for the domain after the relaunch. In the Local Falcon scan of 2026-08-18 the practice held 'frequenztherapie nürnberg' at 87.8 % and 'heilpraktiker nürnberg' at 6.1 %. Today it stands at position 14.6 for 'heilpraktiker nürnberg' (Search Console).
Proof and structured data are thin. Google shows 10 reviews, the competitors in the Local Pack 22 to 107. The MedicalBusiness markup has no opening hours, no sameAs and no service list.
Links. Referring domains: {rd}. Source: DataForSEO backlinks summary, 2026-10-11.

A page for entrepreneurs and a page for heavy metals wait for the client (CP-SVC-021, CP-SVC-022).
Directory work and the Doctolib correction: link and entity work, not pages (CP-AUT-007, CP-LOC-005).
